metadata.description: OPTIONAL subscription-scope deployment that enables the Microsoft Defender for Cloud plans required for this demo: Defender for APIs (Api/P1) and Defender Cloud Security Posture Management (CloudPosture), which drives API security posture findings. Requires Owner or Security Admin rights on the subscription. Deploy with: az deployment sub create --location <region> --template-file infra/pricing.json
Enable Microsoft Defender for APIs (Standard tier, P1 sub-plan).
Enable Defender Cloud Security Posture Management, required for API security posture (discovery/inventory) findings.
Enable Defender CSPM sensitive-data discovery so storage data sensitivity can enrich recommendations and attack paths.
